Terminal GUI for monitoring Firedancer tile and link metrics, with optional Sankey output.

# Purpose
This C file implements the `monitor` action for a Firedancer development command. It parses monitor-specific command-line options in [`monitor_cmd_args`](<#monitor_cmd_args>), checks required privileges and resource limits in `monitor_cmd_perm`, and then runs a terminal-based status display in [`monitor_cmd_fn`](<#monitor_cmd_fn>) and [`run_monitor`](<#run_monitor>). The code can also add a benchmark topology with `add_bench_topo` when `--bench` is set, and it can enter a sandbox or switch user and group IDs before it starts the monitor.

The main function of the file is to read live topology metrics from `fd_topo_t`, `fd_metrics`, `fd_mcache`, and `fd_fseq`, then print a text user interface that shows tile state, link rates, filter counts, overrun counts, and other runtime counters. It also handles terminal setup, signal handling, optional log draining, and an optional Sankey-style summary pane. The file defines the public `fd_action_monitor` descriptor, so it acts as the command entry point for the monitor feature in the Firedancer command framework.
